records.name: Apple ARKit and TrueDepth teacher outputs
records.personal_biometric_consent_basis: Every first-party comparison clip requires clear and conspicuous Face Data consent, a specific evaluation purpose, retention and withdrawal handling, and any required off-device transfer consent.
prohibited_uses: Training, fine-tuning, distillation, pseudo-labeling, calibration, threshold selection, or recipe selection
Copying ARKit coefficients into NTP training truth
Use outside the consented comparison purpose
records.evidence: Apple DPLA section 3.3.3(K) defines and restricts Face Data. Project-owner decision limits ARKit/TrueDepth outputs to an isolated first-party validation/test comparison and grants no training permission.

records.name: MediaPipe Face Landmarker
attribution_obligations: Preserve Apache-2.0 and required MediaPipe notices in the training provenance bundle
records.personal_biometric_consent_basis: MediaPipe processes only separately consented first-party captures; the teacher license does not replace participant consent.
prohibited_uses: Calling predictions ground truth
Identity recognition or user profiling
Using an unpinned model bundle or silently changing the landmark/blendshape mapping
Training confidence as certainty rather than teacher reliability
records.evidence: MediaPipe v0.10.35 code and the official FaceMesh V2/Blendshape V2 model cards identify Apache-2.0. Approved bundle SHA-256: 64184e229b263107bc2b804c6625db1341ff2bb731874b0bcc2fe6544e0bc9ff.

records.name: NanaTracking generated smoke fixtures
records.personal_biometric_consent_basis: No people or biometric recordings are present.
prohibited_uses: Production-quality, real-data, demographic, or target-device acceptance claims
records.evidence: Repository-owned generated arrays and tiny fixtures only.

records.name: OpenCV calibrated geometry derivation
attribution_obligations: Preserve the applicable OpenCV Apache-2.0 notices
records.personal_biometric_consent_basis: OpenCV operates only on separately consented first-party captures; mathematical derivation does not replace participant consent.
prohibited_uses: Using uncalibrated or unsynchronized geometry as observed truth
Promoting MediaPipe-seeded points without multiview reprojection and human-review gates
Treating solvePnP or triangulation residuals as model confidence
records.evidence: OpenCV 4.5.0 and later are Apache-2.0. Only deterministic calibration, triangulation, solvePnP, reprojection, and optical-flow outputs from first-party captures are admitted.

records.personal_biometric_consent_basis: Dataset participant and downstream biometric/likeness basis requires explicit human review.

Checkpoint export or commercial initialization
Download before license and likeness review
records.evidence: Rejected by the project-wide no-existing-datasets policy. Multiface cannot enter training, evaluation, baseline selection, or recipe promotion.
